name.text: Volumes of Solids of Revolution-Washer method-q2

questiontext.text:
Find the volume of the solid generated by revolving the region bounded by \(f(x)={@const1@}-{@var1*x^2@} , g(x)=\sqrt{{@const2@}-{@var2*x^2@} }, x ={@lower_limit@}, \) and \(x={@upper_limit@}\) about the \(x-\) axis using the disk Washer method.

Note: Give your answer in exact form.

\(V=\) [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

Because the revolution is about the \(x-\) axis, the volume is determined as follows

\[\begin{align} V&=\int_a^b \pi \left( [f(x)]^2-[g(x)]^2 \right) dx. \\ &=\displaystyle \int_{{@lower_limit@}}^{{@upper_limit@}} \pi \left( [{@const1@}-x^2]^2-[\sqrt{{@const2@}-x^2}]^2 \right) dx.\\ &= \displaystyle \pi \int_{{@lower_limit@}}^{{@upper_limit@}} \left( [{@expand(((const1-x^2))^2)@}]-[{@const2@}-x^2] \right) dx.\\ &=\displaystyle \pi\int_{{@lower_limit@}}^{{@upper_limit@}} \left[ {@expand(((const1-x^2))^2)-(const2-x^2)@} \right] dx.\\ &=\displaystyle \pi \bigg[ {@ta1@} \bigg]_{{@lower_limit@}}^{{@upper_limit@}}\\ &=\displaystyle {@ta@} \end{align}\]
